natural_context_exception.applies_to: realistic natural contextual regions in genuine photographs and original AI scientific illustrations
allowed_examples: scientifically justified sky and weather context
conditions: present only where relevant to the scene
do not interfere with scientific semantics or labels
white canvas and panel interiors remain mandatory
natural_context_exception.exclusion: No exemption for authored arrows, legends, axes, text, diagrams, data plots, panels or decorative background fills; equipment material realism is allowed in authentic/photo-real physical depictions, not as scientific encoding.
natural_context_exception.restricted_hue_interpretation: A naturally purple, pink or yellow flower may retain its physical color; the same hue is not thereby approved as a scientific graphic, arrow or branded UI token.

photo_exception: Authentic materials and natural phenomena retain physically realistic colors. This covers relevant original AI illustrative natural-context objects as well as photographs; see natural_context_exception. No decorative gradients or scenery backgrounds.

bright_turquoise.role: Optional nonessential emphasis/large strokes ONLY; fails 3:1 white graphic contrast

institutional_exceptions.note: Only these two exact branded colors override previous categorical prohibitions; no other purple/magenta or gold/yellow designed tones are permitted.

photograph_color_policy: Photographic and photorealistic physical objects preserve credible material colors; restrained natural context also applies to original illustrative scenes. These pixel colors are exempt from the 13 authored graphic-mark tokens, but never allow decorative scenic fills.
low_contrast_policy: ASU Gold and Bright Turquoise cannot be used as standalone critical marks or text on white; use only nonessential large accents, paired with high contrast labels or outlines.
color_usage: Only these 13 named sRGB tokens may be used for authored design elements. All canvas, boxes, headers, panels and legend interiors must be #FFFFFF. No colored fills, textures, gradients or shadows.
